([[South Bend, Indiana]]) * [[Franklin Central High School|Franklin Central]]
([[Indianapolis, Indiana]]) * AZ Compass Prep
([[Chandler, Arizona]]) | college = * [[East Carolina Pirates men's basketball|East Carolina]] (2021–2023) * [[Oklahoma State Cowboys basketball|Oklahoma State]] (2023–2024) * [[West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball|West Virginia]] (2024–2025) | highlights = * First-team All-[[Big 12 Conference|Big 12]] (2025) }} '''Javon Small''' (born December 19, 2002) is an American [[college basketball]] player for the [[West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball|West Virginia Mountaineers]] of the [[Big 12 Conference]]. He previously played for the [[East Carolina Pirates men's basketball|East Carolina Pirates]] and for the [[Oklahoma State Cowboys basketball|Oklahoma State Cowboys]]. ==Early life and high school== Coming out of high school, Small was rated as a three-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and committed to play [[college basketball]] for the [[East Carolina Pirates men's basketball|East Carolina Pirates]] over other schools such as Ball State, Akron, Indiana State, IUPUI, Kent State, Southern Illinois and Virginia Tech.{{cite web |last1=Igoe |first1=Stephen |title=Three-star PG Javon Small commits to ECU |url=https://247sports.com/article/javon-small-ecu-basketball-recruiting-commitment-161754283/ |website=247Sports |access-date=March 2, 2025}} ==College career== === East Carolina === As a freshman in 2021–22, Small appeared in just 16 games, playing 9.2 minutes per game.{{cite web |last1=Ankony |first1=Jack |title=Oklahoma State Transfer Javon Small Hears From Indiana |url=https://www.si.com/college/indiana/basketball/oklahoma-state-transfer-javon-small-hears-from-indiana |work=Indiana Hoosiers on SI |publisher=SI.com |access-date=March 2, 2025}} In 2022–23, he averaged 15.8 points, 4.8 rebounds and 5.6 assists per game.{{cite web |last1=Kosko |first1=Nick |title=Oklahoma State transfer Javon Small commits to West Virginia |url=https://www.on3.com/news/oklahoma-state-transfer-javon-small-commits-to-west-virginia/ |website=On3.com |access-date=March 2, 2025}} After the season, Small entered his name into the NCAA transfer portal.{{cite web |last1=Mason |first1=Patrick |title=ECU men's basketball: Small, Sunderland enter transfer portal |url=https://www.reflector.com/sports/college/ecu-mens-basketball-small-sunderland-enter-transfer-portal/article_ba0311e2-1c34-53a0-a2c1-7bf7a01e119b.html |website=The Daily Reflector |access-date=March 2, 2025}} === Oklahoma State === Small transferred to play for the [[Oklahoma State Cowboys men's basketball|Oklahoma State Cowboys]].{{cite web |last1=Wright |first1=Scott |title=How Indiana roots turned Oklahoma State's Javon Small into a 'very cerebral' point guard |url=https://www.oklahoman.com/story/sports/college/cowboys/2024/03/01/oklahoma-state-basketball-javon-indiana-roots-osu-cowboys/72807219007/ |website=The Oklahoman |access-date=March 2, 2025}} On March 9, 2024, he dropped a career-high 34 points versus [[2023–24 BYU Cougars men's basketball team|BYU]].{{cite web |last1=White |first1=Ivan |title=Oklahoma State Guard Javon Small Earns All-Big 12 Honorable Mention |url=https://www.si.com/college/oklahomastate/basketball/oklahoma-state-guard-javon-small-earns-all-big-12-honorable-mention |work=Oklahoma State Cowboys on SI |publisher=SI.com |access-date=March 2, 2025}} During the 2023–24 season, Small appeared in 31 games for the Cowboys, where he averaged 15.1 points, 4.7 rebounds, 4.1 assists, and one steal per game while shooting 44% from the field and 37% from three, earning all-[[Big 12 Conference]] honorable mention.{{cite web |last1=Callihan |first1=Schuyler |title=BREAKING: Oklahoma State Transfer Javon Small Chooses WVU |url=https://www.si.com/college/westvirginia/javon-small-commits-to-wvu |work=West Virginia Mountaineers on SI |publisher=SI.com |access-date=March 2, 2025}} After the conclusion of the 2023–24 season, Small once again entered his name into the NCAA transfer portal.{{cite web |title=OSU men's basketball's Javon Small enters NCAA transfer portal |url=https://www.oklahoman.com/story/sports/college/cowboys/2024/04/08/oklahoma-state-mens-basketball-point-guard-javon-small-enters-ncaa-transfer-portal/73243362007/ |website=The Oklahoman |access-date=March 2, 2025}} === West Virginia === Small transferred to play for the [[West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball|West Virginia Mountaineers]].{{cite web |last1=Unruh |first1=Jacob |title=Big 12 basketball power rankings: West Virginia's Javon Small has Mountaineers climbing |url=https://www.oklahoman.com/story/sports/college/big-12/2025/01/02/big-12-mens-college-basketball-power-rankings-kansas-west-virginia-javon-small-oklahoma-state/77394410007/ |website=The Oklahoman |access-date=March 2, 2025}} In his first game with the Mountaineers on November 4, 2024, he notched 15 points, five assists, two rebounds, two steals and one block in a win over [[2024–25 Robert Morris Colonials men's basketball team|Robert Morris]].{{cite web |last1=Castrilli |first1=Nick |title=Small to lead Men's Basketball backcourt |url=https://www.thedaonline.com/sports/mens_basketball/small-to-lead-mens-basketball-backcourt/article_e82ef8c8-a07c-11ef-959c-9736faf8c4c4.html |website=[[The Daily Athenaeum]] |access-date=March 2, 2025}} On November 27, 2024, Small scored 31 points (highest in his year at WVU) in the matchup with [[Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball|Gonzaga Bulldogs]] in the second game of the [[Battle 4 Atlantis|Bad Boy Mowers Battle 4 Atlantis]] at [[Imperial Arena]] in [[Paradise Island]], [[Bahamas]], securing the win for the Mountaineers 86-78 in overtime.{{cite web |last1=Antonik |first1=John |title=Third-Ranked Bulldogs Bounced in the Bahamas! |url=https://wvusports.com/news/2024/11/27/mens-basketball-third-ranked-bulldogs-bounced-in-the-bahamas.aspx |website=WVU Sports. Men's Basketball |access-date=May 21, 2025}} On December 31, 2024, Small scored 13 points including the game-winning free throw, while also adding 11 rebounds and six assists, as he helped the Mountaineers upset #7 [[2024–25 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|Kansas]].{{cite web |last1=Skretta |first1=Dave |title=Javon Small hits go-ahead FT with 1.8 seconds left, sending West Virginia to 62–61 win over No. 7 KU |url=https://www.theintelligencer.net/sports/top-sports/2025/01/javon-small-hits-go-ahead-ft-with-1-8-seconds-left-sending-west-virginia-to-62-61-win-over-no-7-ku/ |website=The Intelligencer |access-date=March 2, 2025}} On January 4, 2025, he scored 24 points in a 69–50 win over his former team, [[2024–25 Oklahoma State Cowboys basketball team|Oklahoma State]].{{cite web |last1=Unruh |first1=Jacob |title=Oklahoma State basketball overpowered by Javon Small, West Virginia in loss |url=https://www.oklahoman.com/story/sports/college/cowboys/2025/01/04/oklahoma-state-west-virginia-score-live-updates-mens-college-basketball-osu-cowboys/77455730007/ |website=The Oklahoman |access-date=March 2, 2025}} On January 18, 2025, his 12 points in 2 last minutes of the game secured the Mountaineers with a spectacular win over No.2 Iowa State with 64-57 (he scored 27 points in the whole game).{{cite web |last1=Young |first1=Ryan |title=Men's basketball AP poll: Iowa State slips as Auburn survives chaotic week in the SEC |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/mens-basketball-ap-poll-iowa-state-slips-as-auburn-survives-chaotic-week-in-the-sec-182544875.html |publisher=Yahoo!Sports |date=January 20, 2025|access-date=May 22, 2025}} On February 25, 2025, Small posted 23 points, ten assists, and five rebounds in a win over [[2024–25 TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team|TCU]].{{cite web |last1=Callihan |first1=Schuyler |title=Javon Small Proves Once Again Why He Should Be the Big 12 Player of the Year |url=https://www.si.com/college/westvirginia/basketball/javon-small-proves-once-again-why-he-should-be-the-big-12-player-of-the-year |work=West Virginia Mountaineers on SI |publisher=SI.com |access-date=March 2, 2025}} During his year with the Mountaineers he scored 20 or more points in 14 games.{{cite web |title=Javon Small. Game-By-Game Statistics |url=https://wvusports.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/javon-small/17987 |publisher=WVU Sports. Men's Basketball |access-date=May 21, 2025}} On March 30, 2025, he officially declared for the [[2025 NBA draft]],{{cite web |last1=Centofanti |first1=Dante |title=WVU Men’s Basketball Senior Javon Small declares for NBA Draft |url=https://www.wdtv.com/2025/03/30/wvu-mens-basketball-senior-javon-small-declares-nba-draft/ |website=WDTV |access-date=May 17, 2025}} and was invited to the 2025 [[NBA draft combine]] on May 2.{{cite web |last1=Hall |first1=Christopher |title=Javon Small Receives an Invite to the 2025 NBA Draft Combine |url=https://www.si.com/college/westvirginia/baseball/javon-small-receives-an-invite-to-the-2025-nba-draft-combine |website=Sports Illustrated |access-date=May 17, 2025}} Javon Small graduated from [[West Virginia University]] with Regents Bachelor of Arts degree on May 18, 2025.{{cite web |title=Eberly College of Arts and Sciences. May 2025 Graduates |url=https://graduation.wvu.edu/wvu-spring-2025/eberly-college-of-arts-and-sciences |website=[[West Virginia University]] |access-date=May 18, 2025}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA
